text:
marie: quick heads-up -- requesting a quiet-window exception tonight 00:00-02:00 UTC to unpin runtime 2.15 -> 2.15.1 for the llm-quant model group. Hotpatch fixed the perf regression; holding the unpin is causing queue growth in eu-west-1. Need ops/release sign-off so we can do a region-limited staged unpin.

deploy-bot: FYI: existing infra maintenance scheduled at 00:30 UTC in eu-west-1. Potential conflict. Reply with 'approve' to proceed with exception, 'hold' to block.

eric: can we do a staged rollout limited to eu-west first (canary on 3 hosts) before broader unpin? prefer to avoid changing NA until we validate.

marie: yes -- plan is staged: eu-west canary (3 hosts) -> run smoke & perf checks -> roll rest of eu-west pool. Rollback plan: re-add 2.15 to pinned list and roll traffic to pinned runtime if regressions reappear. Operator steps below.

# operator steps
deploybot schedule unpin --model-group llm-quant --from-runtime 2.15 --to-runtime 2.15.1 --regions eu-west-1 --canary 3 --start 00:05UTC
# smoke tests (ops)
./infra/tests/run_smoke.sh --hosts canary-hosts
# rollback (if needed)
deploybot pin-runtime --runtime 2.15 --model-group llm-quant --region eu-west-1

sasha: a quick compatibility note -- SDK surface: we validated with sdk 3.2.0 but saw a tokenization edgecase; fix landed in 3.2.1. If customers are pinned to sdk 3.2.0 in NA, we should avoid global unpin until NA is on 3.2.1. eu-west infra already shows sdk 3.2.1 in our inventory.

marie: thanks -- good catch. So: staged unpin for eu-west only tonight. For NA, keep pin until sdk 3.2.1 pickup (scheduled later this week). I'll add a short release note and a migration blurb for SDK users.

nina: I'll run the smoke+perf quickset on the canary hosts and post results here before the roll. ETA 45m.

nina: smoke results: canary x3 running for 30m. p50 latency back to baseline, no error spikes in logs, KV cache hit-rate normal. posting logs to the quiet-window bucket: s3://ci-logs/quiet-window/8150002468-smoke.log :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Scheduled unpin action queued at 00:05 UTC for eu-west-1. Operator assigned: @eric. Please ack to confirm presence during the rollback window.

eric: ack and approving. I'll be oncall/online for the 00:00-02:00 window and can trigger rollback if telemetry looks off. :+1:

marie: thanks all -- proceeding to schedule the region-limited unpin. Will update release notes and post a postmortem checklist if anything flares.
